about: On Catherby's beach (::tele 2850 3430) with 99 Fishing and Cooking, a harpoon, a lobster pot, a big fishing net, a tinderbox and logs, so every fish Fishing and Cooking 2 has built so far can be caught and cooked. The bank holds the dragon and barb-tail harpoons to try the better and wieldable harpoons. Musa Point's spots are at ::tele 2924 3178.
notes: For Fishing and Cooking 2's checks by hand. Each later step adds its tools and bait here. The loadout is ours.
